title: Reticulata
description: This is modpack for optimized minecraft.
body:
# Reticulata
**Lightweight. Powerful. Performance-First.**  
Reticulata is a streamlined modpack dedicated solely to optimizing your Minecraft experience.

## NOTE
* **Maintenance:** My life is very busy, so I'm slow for fixes. If you have issue, use **[this](https://github.com/tsyqax/Reticidus)**.
* **Updates:** Updates will be released whenever I personally open new Minecraft version.
* **Versions:** A.B.C // A = Big or Main update, B = MC version change, C = small change

## Is this effective?
> Disclaimer: This is not a detail benchmark.  
> Results are based on "ice-camera standing" tests.

| Version | Average FPS | Max FPS |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Vanilla | 326 | 352 |
| Another Cool Modpack | **344** | 377 |
| **Reticulata** | 342 | **398** |

---

## Included Content
### Mods
* **Performance:** Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, C2me, BadOptimizations, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast, More Culling, NoisiumForked, ScalableLux
* **Utility:** Fabric API, Cloth Config, Mod Menu, FPS Reducer, Gamma Utils, Opti Zoom
* **Visuals:** Iris, Sodium Extra, BBE
* **Inactive/Excluded:** *No Chat Reports, ThreadTweak, very many player*  
* Does not mean they are wrong or bad if some mods are disabled.

### Shaders
* Mellow Shader
* VECTOR
* Flashlight Shader
* *Lucidus*

### Extras
* **Pre-configured Options:** Sodium, Sodium-Extra, and Shader settings.
* icon.png included.
